title: Log back in to a bank portal that the browser already knows
description: On the logged-out page or the login page of an Atruvia / VR banking portal: leaves the logged-out page for the login page, then presses Anmelden and waits for the start page with its Postfach button. It never types, reads or fills anything: the browser's own password manager has to have filled the VR-NetKey and the PIN. If the portal asks for a second factor (TAN, SecureGo, a new device) or the PIN was not filled, the run FAILS: ask the person to log in themselves, then continue with atruvia/list-postbox. Matched on any bank's domain by the portal's paths.

steps.note: Only the logged-out page has this button; on the login page the step is skipped.

steps.failMessage: The login page did not appear. Ask the person to open the bank portal and log in themselves.

steps.note: Presses the button only. The browser's password manager must already have filled the fields.

steps.failMessage: Not logged in: the portal stayed on the login page (no saved PIN) or asks for a second factor (TAN, SecureGo, new device). Beifahrer never fills a password or a TAN. Ask the person to log in themselves, then continue.
